question: True or false: your own component can name its handler prop onSmash instead of onClick.
say: True or false: your own component can name its handler prop onSmash instead of onClick.
explanation: True. Only built-in tags like <button> need browser event names. Your own props can have any name, by convention on + Capital.
explainSay: True. Your own components can name handler props anything. The convention is on plus a capital letter.
